messages.subject: ‘Waiting 5 minutes’
parts:
Hi,

Whenever there is Map Reduce kind of work going on (e.g., using datadr::drRead.csv() or datadr::divide()) on HDFS connection data, there is a message that says

‘Waiting 5 minutes’

I think the actual Map or Reduce task is gets interrupted (goes into sleep) for a while.

Is there a reason for this? I think this is happening at RHIPE level.

The system I am using is Amazon Web Service (AWS) Elastic Map Reduce (EMR) with v2.4.2 image.
RHIPE version is 0.74

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 556a8204bb220314
messages.subject: Re: ‘Waiting 5 minutes’
parts: We saw a problem similar to this about 9 months ago where the console would stop updating but the MR jobs would complete in the background. It happened only intermittently to us and only on Amazon EMR clusters, but we never figured out the cause. However it hasn't happened recently. Is there a particular reason you're using such old versions of AMI and Rhipe? It might help to update to the newest versions.

messages.author: 860c5575d174c865
messages.subject: Re: ‘Waiting 5 minutes’
parts:
I am using older AMI version because according to the EMR install page for Tessera  RHIPE v0.74 only works with Google Protobufs v2.4.1, and RHIPE v0.75 failed to work with Protobufs v2.5. According to the AMI versions in EMR,  AMI v3.0.3 is where Protobufs 2.5 got installed by default, so I use an older AMI.

I didn't modify the EMR scripts for installation of RHIPE and Protobufs. RHIPE is being downloaded from:
http://people.mozilla.com/~sguha/Rhipe_0.74.0_hadoop-1.tar.gz

Should I be grabbing the latest RHIPE directly from GitHub instead? In the setting up Tessera on a cluster PDF, RHIPE v0.74 is downloaded from Purdue University and it is also using Protobufs v2.4.1.

What version of AMI did you manage to deploy Tessera successfully with?
